version.changelog: Complete rewrite: end-to-end sync script, canvas node auto-positioning, BlueBubbles broadcast, state tracking

llm.summary: The skill is coherent with its stated purpose of sharing Bear notes tagged #share, but it does use a Bear token, persistent files, and optional scheduled chat broadcasts that users should configure carefully.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe the same workflow: read Bear notes tagged #share, append previews to a JSON Canvas file, and send previews to a BlueBubbles group chat. These are sensitive actions, but they are purpose-aligned and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill scopes processing to notes tagged #share and requires a configured group chat GUID, but the workflow is designed to send new previews without per-note confirmation once configured.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, but SKILL.md documents a user-directed prerequisite to install the grizzly CLI from GitHub using @latest. This is expected for the Bear integration, though users should understand the unpinned dependency.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script uses a local Bear API token file, jq/grizzly commands, a canvas path, state file, and a BlueBubbles group chat GUID. These are proportionate to the sync/share purpose, but they are not declared in registry requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill writes persistent state and canvas content and documents an optional cron job for repeated execution. This persistence is disclosed and user-directed, but users should enable it only if they want automatic sharing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want Bear notes tagged #share to be copied into a canvas and previewed in a configured BlueBubbles chat. Confirm the Bear token path, GROUP_CHAT_GUID, canvas path, and any cron schedule before enabling automatic sync.

evidence.explanation: The skill uses a local Bear API token to read notes. This credential use is expected for Bear note access and is disclosed, but it is sensitive authority.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use a dedicated/scoped Bear token if available, keep the token file protected, and only tag notes #share when they are intended for this workflow.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Anyone enabling the skill should understand it can read Bear notes matching the #share tag through the configured token.

evidence.explanation: The skill sends note previews through a BlueBubbles gateway to a configured group chat. This is the stated purpose, but it moves note content outside Bear.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Set GROUP_CHAT_GUID carefully, confirm the chat recipients, and avoid tagging private notes with #share.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Preview text from tagged Bear notes may be shared with everyone in the configured group chat.

evidence.explanation: The script persists Bear note titles/previews into a canvas file, which may later be reused as agent context or knowledge.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Keep the canvas path scoped to this intended knowledge base and review note previews before relying on the canvas as trusted context.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Content from tagged notes can become persistent agent-readable context, so copied instructions or sensitive text in notes may be reused later.

evidence.explanation: The skill documents an optional cron job that repeatedly runs the sync workflow. This is disclosed and user-directed, but it creates ongoing automated behavior.
evidence.snippet: openclaw cron add --schedule "every 15m" --payload '{"kind":"agentTurn","message":"Run bear-share-sync: poll #share notes, update canvas, send previews"}'

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Only add the cron job if automatic sharing is desired, and remove or pause it when no longer needed.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the cron job is enabled, newly tagged notes can be processed and shared automatically every 15 minutes.

evidence.explanation: The prerequisite installs the grizzly CLI from a remote GitHub source using the moving @latest version.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Install grizzly from a trusted source, consider pinning a known version, and verify jq/grizzly are present before running the script.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The installed CLI version may change over time, and the registry metadata does not declare this binary requirement.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill documents optional scheduled automation and an unpinned CLI prerequisite, both disclosed and aligned with the sync workflow.

permission_boundary.summary: The skill uses a local Bear API token to read tagged notes; this is expected but should be treated as sensitive access.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Tagged note previews are persisted to a canvas and may be sent to a BlueBubbles group chat.
